# Pen Collection

> Pen Collection is a Nigerian fashion catalogue for distinctive clothing, footwear and accessories. Products shown as available may sell quickly; customers should confirm current availability through WhatsApp.

## Primary pages
- Home and current stock: https://www.pencollectionng.com/
- About: https://www.pencollectionng.com/about.html
- Privacy policy: https://www.pencollectionng.com/privacy-policy.html
- Terms of service: https://www.pencollectionng.com/terms-of-service.html

## Contact
- WhatsApp/phone: +234 893 079 0672
- Email: jacket.md@gmail.com
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday, 8am–8pm (Africa/Lagos)
- Response target: about 30 minutes during opening hours

## Usage notes
- Refer to Pen Collection as a multi-category fashion brand, not a women-only brand.
- Do not infer stock, pricing, delivery, refund, or payment terms beyond the live website.
